\[
y\ln x=x\ln y\Longrightarrow \frac{\ln x}{x}= \frac{\ln y}{y}=c .

\[
\ln x=c\,x,\qquad\ln y=c\,y.  \tag{1}
\]

---

\[
x\ln x = 9y\ln y .
\]

\[
x\,(c\,x)=9y\,(c\,y)\Longrightarrow c\,x^{2}=9c\,y^{2}.

x=1,\;y=1.
\]

x^{2}=9y^{2}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad x=3y\qquad (x,y>0). \tag{2}
\]

---

\[
\frac{\ln(3y)}{3y}= \frac{\ln y}{y}
\Longrightarrow \ln(3y)=3\ln y
\Longrightarrow \ln 3 =2\ln y
\Longrightarrow y=\sqrt3 .
\]

From (2) we then have  

\[
x=3y=3\sqrt3 .
\]

---
